Evaluate new tools, manage integrations and automations, and oversee the related budget.• Ensure data quality: Establish and maintain data governance standards to ensure accurate and consistent CRM and billing data in close collaboration with Finance.• Enable sales planning: Partner with Finance and Sales leadership on territory planning, capacity planning, quotas and commission structures.• Manage commission calculations: Take ownership of quarterly sales commission calculations, ensuring accuracy based on CRM data and agreed commission plans.• Scale internationally: Build and standardize revenue processes that support our growing teams across Germany, the UK and the US.• Drive continuous improvement: Proactively identify bottlenecks and inefficiencies in our revenue engine and develop actionable improvement proposals.• Enable our teams: Create clear documentation, onboarding materials and regular training to empower our Go-to-Market teams.• Deliver with accountability: Run RevOps as a service, with clearly defined scopes, committed delivery dates and transparent tracking of requests and projects.Your profileYou are a structured, analytical and proactive RevOps professional who enjoys turning complex processes and messy data into scalable systems. You combine strategic thinking with a hands-on mentality and take ownership from identifying a problem to delivering a solution.Ideally, you bring:• 3+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations or a similar role, preferably in a B2B SaaS scale-up.• Hands-on experience administering HubSpot, including workflows, properties, reporting and integrations.• Experience with Apollo, n8n and Clay is a strong plus.• Strong analytical skills and confidence working with complex or imperfect datasets. SQL or advanced spreadsheet skills are an advantage.• A structured, pragmatic and results-oriented mindset. German is a plus.What we offer?• Real Flexibility: A beautiful office in Berlin-Mitte (with an in-house gym!) and a hybrid setup that actually respects work-life balance• High-End Tech: Sell a product at the cutting edge of AI and Predictive Analytics• Culture & Perks: Regular team off-sites, and a high-trust environment where feedback is a gift, not a chore• Real Time Off: Enjoy 30 days of vacation per year to recharge and maintain a healthy work-life balance• Culture of Trust: Work in a high-trust environment where open communication and constructive feedback are part of everyday life• Ownership & Autonomy: Take responsibility, make an impact, and enjoy a high degree of personal ownership in your roleAbout us7Learnings is one of the leading retail optimization platforms. We help retailers to optimize their pricing and marketing spend. Our solution uses advanced machine learning models to forecast demand for different price points with high accuracy. With our powerful self-learning algorithms, retailers can increase their profitability and revenues by up to 10%. We offer the most intuitive way to steer prices. Our prices simply maximize the business goals set by our clients. Our solution is easy to integrate and offers a high return on investment.

jobs.description: ABOUT THE ROLEIn our Certification & Safety team, you make sure that safety is designed into our next-generation Unmanned Aircraft Systems (UAS) from the start. Working closely with the engineering teams, you carry safety requirements through the entire development lifecycle, from the first hazard assessment to the certification evidence.As a senior engineer, you handle complex safety tasks independently and bring your practical experience into technical discussions and design decisions.WHAT YOU WILL DO • Perform aircraft- and system-level safety assessments, including FHA, PSSA, SSA, FTA, FMEA and Common Cause Analyses • Identify and classify failure conditions, derive safety requirements and support their allocation to systems and equipment • Evaluate system architectures, failure modes, redundancy concepts and mitigation measures • Support the determination of Functional and Item Development Assurance Levels (FDAL/IDAL) • Work with engineering teams, suppliers and certification specialists to implement and verify safety requirements • Prepare and review safety documentation and evidence for certification and design reviews • Help improve our safety engineering practices and support colleagues with your expertiseWHAT YOU BRING • A degree in Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a related field • Deep, hands-on experience in aerospace safety engineering and safety assessment methods (FHA, PSSA, FTA, FMEA, CCA) • Solid knowledge of ARP4761/ARP4761A and ARP4754A/B • Experience translating safety assessment results into engineering requirements and architectural decisions • The ability to define, communicate and execute robust safety processes independently in a dynamic startup environment • Clear communication across engineering disciplines and a thorough, diligent way of working • Fluent EnglishMoreover, it would be helpful if you also• have experience with UAS, EASA SC Light-UAS, Design Verification Reports (DVR) or military airworthiness requirements• know DO-178C/DO-254 and development assurance processes• are familiar with safety analysis tools such as Isograph FaultTree+ and requirements management tools such as Polarion• have worked directly with aviation certification authorities• speak GermanWHAT WE OFFER • Full-scale aerospace engineering, not concept slides • A 60+ engineer team at Ottobrunn • Real ownership and flat hierarchies: a modern startup culture where your input shapes decisions, not just execution • Flexible working hours, remote work, and competitive compensation • Health & wellbeing: EGYM Wellpass membership and subsidized lunch in our canteen • Office extras: espresso coffee, fresh fruit, and soft drinks, plus regular team and company events, and plenty more once you're on boardAbout usclick here!Built for purpose.When time matters.ERC was founded to close Europe's critical capability gap in the sky.
